title: The Real Python Podcast – Episode #318: Free-Threaded Python: Why Python Devs Should Know About the ABI
description: Why should every Python developer know about the CPython ABI? This week on the show, we speak with Nathan Goldbaum about free-threaded Python and the changes to the Python Application Binary Interface.
